description: This file contains C source code for management server APIs related to Cosa (CPE Open Service API) functions. It includes functions to retrieve host paths based on MAC addresses, count lines in files, check lease availability for MAC addresses, retrieve manageable device lists from files, and build DHCP vendor client files. The file handles interaction with host data structures, file I/O, and device management logic, specifically tailored for a network management context.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaDmlGetHostPath(char * value,char * hostPath,ULONG hostPathSize)
methods.description: Retrieves the host path string for a given MAC address from the hosts table.

methods.name: unsigned int countlines(char * filename)
methods.description: Counts the number of lines in a specified file.

methods.name: int IsLeaseAvailable(char * macaddr)
methods.description: Checks if a DHCP lease is available (not expired) for a given MAC address.

methods.name: PCOSA_DML_MANG_DEV CosaDmlGetManageableDevices(ULONG * tableEntryCount,char * filename)
methods.description: Reads manageable device entries from a specified file, returning a list of device structures if leases are valid.

methods.name: void buildDhcpVendorClientsFile()
methods.description: Creates a combined DHCP vendor clients file from IPv4 and IPv6 files.
